reviews.notes: North upland: field massing rising 0..2 toward the north edge, crag outcrops (andesite, tuff, cobble, moss breakup) kept 9 clear of the lanes, mantlets at z -150/-128 on graded pads with low banks. Locks ok.
West upland falls to the wet north meadow; north lane bends round the bluff's west foot; meadow puddles flush with the mud. Upland contours still read as soft terraces (natural pass).
North bluff rises to about 70 on a warped, uneven foot with bare rock where it steepens; lane runs along its foot, hidden from the gate towers. Wet patches could be fewer near the lane.

Burned village: five roofless blackstone shells with broken tops 64..68 and one doorway each, on ash and gravel; bluff behind; north lane into A. The corner nearest A is broken to the ground for the capture ring.
A supply yard: level pad at 63 under the ring, broken wall stubs at r 21 clear of the lanes; north ford eased to a 1-deep gravel shoal; river rises into its gorge mouth toward the rim.

North ford tidied like F5 (Kort 2026-10-31): the wide pool is gone; a slanting gravel bar 1 under the water crosses the kept channel from z -127 (A side) to z -134, gravel ramps down the west cliff from the A yard and up the east cliff to the reach track's end. A ring untouched at y 64..67. Locks ok.
North reach: open wet bank east of the river, worn track to the ford, banks rising toward the rim. Quiet by design.
East watch north: wet meadow at 62..63 with pools and moss, continuing the north flank's swells and breakup from G1; east watchtower x 145..155, z -155..-145, top 79 with cracked crown. Locks ok.

Camp north: shelf y 72 with warped lip and earth/crag slope settled by thermal erosion; palisade east run and north run z -72, lane gate z -64 with the rerouted north lane leaving between tents; white tent, mantlet row x -235. Locks ok.
Mire north edge with pools, watchtower (-180,-85) cracked to 75..77, north lane on dry ground above the Mire.
Supply yard and house unchanged in form; trench runs end short of the z -41 crossing; meadow puddles north of the yard.

NW corner tower (cracked to 74..76) and north curtain at 71; A-to-sally-gap track goes round the fosse end outside the curtain, then a cobble causeway over the fosse at z -62. Village houses 3 and 4 on the ash ground.
North curtain with the water-gate arch: the river cuts it, a lintel spans y 68..71; inner yard and bailey ground carried to z -93.

East bailey north: andesite yard with low swells, north-wall track to the NE tower stair, two lean-to sheds on the north curtain, north store, carts and crate stacks as low cover off the tracks. Rough massing for the structure pass.

Supply east north: NE corner tower (x 96..106, z -100..-92, top 76) closing the north curtain onto the east curtain at x 98..102 (top 71); NE supply yard (cobble wall top 66, gate on the court side at x 124..128) with its house volume 57..70; NE spur in from the court; wet meadow beyond z -98. Locks ok.

Siege camp gate: King's Road gate z -8..8 with 3x3 posts and lintel, gate ramp eased over 16; trodden shelf floor (paths, gravel, packed mud), grey tent, north trebuchet massing on the shelf edge, mantlets shifted clear of road and lanes. Locks ok.

reviews.notes: Mire north-west: mud at 61-62 with a ragged graded edge (fbm-wobbled distance field), noise hummocks, bog pools as river ops; King's Road path forks onto the raised cobble-edged causeway (y 63) with ragged verges; upland rises west with noise-warped contours. West Mire edge still fairly even; soften in the natural pass. Locks ok.
